Text.Text: Please do not touch the specimen jars, because half of them are venomous and I have not tested the rest. I'm Dr. Imra Sol, from Czerka xenobiology. Did the company send you, or did you wander in?
These glands and joints are intact, which almost never happens. I will have a first batch of antivenom by tomorrow. Here is the department's fee for your work.
You are back from the Hidden Cave. Did you bring me the six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs for the antivenom?

Two rangers came back from the Hidden Cave with Gaping Spider bites that I could not treat. The venom gland sits in the gut, and the leg joints carry a weaker form of the same toxin. I need you to bring me six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs from the Gaping Spiders in that cave, so I can make an antivenom. I will pay you a fee.
Good. Collect six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs from the Gaping Spiders in the Hidden Cave, north-east of here, then bring them back to me. Please wear gloves.
The Hidden Cave is north-east of this landing. It is the first place every new arrival walks into, which is why I treat so many spider bites.
The Kwi are in there too. The tribals use the cave as a road, and their shamans travel with them. They will attack you for being on it.
I still need six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs from the Gaping Spiders in the Hidden Cave, north-east of this landing. Bring them to me when you have all of them.
Then the cave road is open and my field season can begin. Here is your fee. I will try to find you some work that has fewer legs.
You are back, and a survey team walked through the Hidden Cave this morning without a cutting torch. Did you kill all ten Gaping Spiders?

It can be made safer. The Gaping Spiders have webbed the Hidden Cave from wall to wall, and every survey team I send has to cut its way through. I need you to go into the Hidden Cave and kill ten Gaping Spiders, so the webs thin out enough to walk. Come back to me afterward and I will pay your fee.
Good. Kill ten Gaping Spiders in the Hidden Cave, north-east of this landing, then come back to me here. Burn the webs if you can, but do not breathe the smoke.
I want my colleagues to stay alive. I already have plenty of spider specimens in these jars, but I am running short on colleagues.
I still need you to kill ten Gaping Spiders in the Hidden Cave, north-east of this landing. Come back to me when all ten are dead, because the cave is still webbed shut.
Thank you. Here is your fee. Now I can go and find out what the Kwi have been leaving inside those ruins.
You are back, and my survey drone can see the ruin entrances again. Did you kill all twelve Purbole?

Yes, the Purbole are. They are quick, clever pack hunters, and they have denned in every ruin I want to study. I need you to kill twelve Purbole in the Cave Ruins, the Ruin Base or the Grotto Caverns. Come back to me when it is done and I will pay your fee. I would like fewer of them around while I work.
Good. Kill twelve Purbole in the Cave Ruins, the Ruin Base or the Grotto Caverns, then come back to me here. They like to circle you, so keep your back to a wall.
I think the Kwi leave offerings at the ruins and the Purbole have learned to wait for them. That is only a guess, because I cannot stand in a ruin long enough to prove it.
I still need you to kill twelve Purbole. They den in the Cave Ruins, the Ruin Base and the Grotto Caverns. Come back to me when all twelve are dead.
Here is the survey rate, which is considerably better than the pest rate. The second species is worse. Ask me about it when you have stopped limping.
You are back from the mountains, and the footage is excellent. I did not know that Sprantal flank. Did you kill all ten?

It is my real job here. Czerka wants to know which species sits at the top of the food chain before it builds anything permanent, and I have three candidates. The first is the Sprantal. I need you to kill ten Sprantal in the Mountains or the Mountain Caves while my drone records how they fight. Come back to me afterward and I will pay the survey rate.
Good. Kill ten Sprantal in the Mountains or the Mountain Caves, then come back to me here at the landing. Try to make the fights last, because longer footage is more useful.
You are the instrument, and a well-paid one. I will be watching through the drone and taking notes on how the Sprantal respond to you.
Sprantal are armored, territorial, and very fast when they charge downhill. They hold the high ground in the Mountains and the Mountain Caves.
I still need you to kill ten Sprantal in the Mountains or the Mountain Caves. Come back to me when all ten are dead. My drone is waiting to record it.
Here is the survey rate again. There is one candidate left, and it is the one I would bet my own money on. Ask me about it when you are ready.
You are back, and the drone shows that the Squellbugs closed ranks, just as I predicted. Did you kill all twelve?

The second species is the Squellbug. Do not laugh at the name, because a swarm of them stripped a company speeder to the frame in four minutes. I need you to kill twelve Squellbugs in the Grottos, the Mountains or the Mountain Caves, so I can see whether they scatter or close ranks. Come back to me afterward for the survey rate.
Good. Kill twelve Squellbugs, then come back to me here at the landing. The Grottos have the most, and the Mountains and the Mountain Caves have them as well.
I expect them to close ranks around you when they start losing. That is exactly why I am not the one going out there.
I still need you to kill twelve Squellbugs in the Grottos, the Mountains or the Mountain Caves. Come back to me when all twelve are dead.
The second candidate species comes next. Finish the Sprantal survey first, because I cannot analyze two sets of data at the same time.
My conclusion is that the apex predator on Dathomir is whoever the company hires. Here is your rate, with my thanks. I will keep paying for footage if you want more work.
You came back, so my report finally has a conclusion, and Czerka is not going to like it. Did you kill all ten Ssurians?

The last species is the Ssurian. They hunt the grottos, and nothing else down there hunts them. Czerka still wants numbers, so I need you to kill ten Ssurians in the Grottos, the Grotto Caverns or the Mountain Caves. Come back to me afterward for the survey rate. If you do come back, then you are the apex predator, not the Ssurian.
Good. Kill ten Ssurians in the Grottos, the Grotto Caverns or the Mountain Caves, then come back to me here at the landing. Be careful, because they ambush from the water.
No, it was not meant to reassure you. It was meant to be accurate, and I would rather you went in knowing what Ssurians are.
I still need you to kill ten Ssurians in the Grottos, the Grotto Caverns or the Mountain Caves. Come back to me when all ten are dead.
The last candidate species comes next. You need to finish the Squellbug survey for me before I can send you after it.
Here is the data rate for this sweep. Come back whenever you want to run another one, because a study like this never really ends.
You are back, and the drone caught most of it. Did you finish the sweep of ten Sprantal and ten Ssurians?

I always do. Populations shift, and one survey is only a picture, not a study. Whenever you have the time, I need you to kill ten Sprantal and ten Ssurians while my drone records it. Come back to me after each sweep and I will pay you the data rate. You can do this as often as you like.
Good. Kill ten Sprantal and ten Ssurians, then come back to me here at the landing. The Sprantal are in the Mountains and the Ssurians are in the Grottos.
I still need you to kill ten Sprantal and ten Ssurians for this sweep. Look in the Mountains for the Sprantal and the Grottos for the Ssurians, then come back to me.
I will leave you to your work, Doctor.
What else are you working on, Doctor?
Yes, here are all of your samples.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll bring you six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs.
Not right now. I would rather avoid spiders.
Where is the Hidden Cave?
What else is inside the cave?
Do you need any samples collected for your research?
Here are six Spider Guts and six Spider Legs.
I am still collecting the samples for you.
Remind me which spider samples you need.
Yes, all ten Gaping Spiders are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill ten Gaping Spiders in the Hidden Cave.
Not right now. Find another exterminator.
Why does a biologist want her specimens killed?
Can the Hidden Cave be made safe?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Gaping Spiders.
Yes, all twelve Purbole are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill twelve Purbole in the ruins.
Not right now. I will stay out of the ruins.
Why are there so many Purbole in the ruins?
Is anything else stopping your surveys?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Purbole.
Yes, I killed ten Sprantal for your notes.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill ten Sprantal for your survey.
Not right now. Find another instrument.
So you are using me as the experiment?
What kind of animal is a Sprantal?
What is the apex predator survey?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need for the Sprantal survey.
Yes, all twelve Squellbugs are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill twelve Squellbugs for your survey.
Not right now. I have seen enough bugs.
Do you expect them to scatter or close ranks?
What is the second species in your survey?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need for the Squellbug survey.
What comes after the Sprantal survey?
Yes, all ten are dead. What is your conclusion?
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll kill ten Ssurians for your survey.
Not right now. I will leave that question open.
Is that supposed to reassure me?
What is the last species in your survey?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need for the Ssurian survey.
What comes after the Squellbug survey?
Yes, I killed ten of each.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll run a sweep. Ten Sprantal and ten Ssurians.
Not this time, Doctor.
Do you still want more survey footage?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need for the sweep.
